claimChecks.claim: Ureter feeder direction implies medial abdominal and lateral pelvic dissection
claimChecks.note: The printed opposite-side directions were reversed; replaced with preservation of feeders and adventitia rather than a universal plane.

claimChecks.claim: Universal ureter mobilization and stenting prevent injury; uterine crossing always most common site
claimChecks.note: Location varies; visually identify and dissect carefully. Stents may aid identification in complex cases, without proven universal prevention.

claimChecks.claim: Chronic dilation permanently removes human contractility
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract: 15 healthy and 11 hydronephrotic pigs
claimChecks.note: Animal coordination finding does not prove irreversible human non-recovery.

claimChecks.claim: Stents always eliminate peristalsis and make kinks safe
claimChecks.note: Effects vary over time and model; no universal human mechanism established.

claimChecks.claim: 5:1 tunnel ratio mandatory for every reimplantation
claimChecks.locator: Finite-element abstract, model conditions and conclusion
claimChecks.note: Historical heuristic retained; model found operative-state implementation could overestimate required length.

claimChecks.claim: Every adult reimplantation must have a submucosal anti-reflux tunnel
claimChecks.locator: Original retrospective series Methods/Surgical technique; 60 patients
claimChecks.note: Its refluxing extravesical UNC approach included psoas hitch and Boari cases; this shows an option, not superiority or universal practice.

claimChecks.claim: Iliac crossing is one of three common stone lodgment sites
claimChecks.note: Only one stone at crossing in cohort; no universal distribution inferred.
